# Retained Metapad cleanup iteration

These are conditional regression inputs for the actual 0x5606 cleanup iteration.
The exact slice contains the nine iteration transfers and the outgoing 0x560d
context. Its manifest binds the retained transfer plan and every original file.
The authored source comes from the retained full cleanup candidate, including
manual proof markers. The interface is the existing cleanup interface.

`ordinary.c.in` erases the proof macros, `marked.c.in` inserts empty calls, and
`pair.c.in` resumes the loop using checked local restoration and assertion-only
exit observers. Tests substitute the current sparse-memory, view and reference
runtimes and generate current portable headers before compiling all three.
Compiled marker erasure, region/body/return correspondence, live observer
arguments and view helper bodies are checked before the complete paired query.
A wrong authored store passes structural correspondence but fails equivalence.

The runtime contract assumes a live immutable NUL-ended text span and a disjoint
scratch span or failed allocation, the retained cursor/count invariant and zero
scratch suffix. The private frame has an arbitrary count and two temporary bytes.
The tests preserve current memory, check normal/fault outcomes and loop progress;
they do not qualify original allocation or native entry/ABI behavior.

The original copy block 0x5601 also has an incoming edge from 0x55fa, outside this
loop entry. These files do not establish exclusive single-entry ownership,
complete caller coverage, a replacement group, or public proof-import authority.
Shared entry composition and public multi-level network validation remain open.
